name: 3d-skill
description: Plan, build, preview and iterate production 3D for the web and Blender: references to spec to brief to build, with versioned previews.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, preview and iterate web 3D and Blender
interface.longDescription: Turn a request and reference images or video into a measured spec, brief and shot list, then build three.js/R3F scenes, shaders, scroll-driven 3D, GLB pipelines and Blender assets, with versioned previews you review and iterate on.
defaultPrompt: Use $3d to plan and build a scroll-driven 3D hero for my homepage from these references.
Use $3d to optimize this GLB for the web and report the budget.
Use $3d to build a Blender product turntable and export a web-ready GLB.
